newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to open Houston office end of March.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to open Houston office end of March.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said it will open its first office in Texas at the end of March to expand its presence the U.S. Gulf Coast region where some of the largest energy market participants are located.
Deniese Palmer-Huggins, former treasurer of Bayoil (USA) and manager of Bayoil SA will head up the office as director.

Paul Beenan, who has represented NYMEX in Houston for 15 years, will continue as Gulf Coast coordinator. Although NYMEX has had representatives in Texas, officials said this the first time NYMEX will have an official base of operation there.
The Houston office will be part of NYMEX's marketing department.
